race.description: Cetnaj Tamworth Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: TIGRIOS (11) wasn't fancied on debut when a tidy second over 1300m at Scone. Looks to have a ton of upside and can go one better here. TASMAN DEEL (3) well-bred Dundeel gelding given plenty of time to mature. Warmed up late from the wide gate with a respectable third over 1300m at Scone. Gets a similar set-up again and will keep improving as he gets out in trip. Go close. KENISIS (7) returns after five-and-a-half months in the paddock. Expected to go on with it this prep after placing in some strong races earlier in the year. Fitted with the one 1000m trial and comes up with the rails draw. FOLKDANCE (12) Maurice filly from Niello on debut. Ran sixth at recent trial and stable have a strong strike rate with the first starters. Watch for any market confidence.
